D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/.signature: theorem compatible_cycle_card [Finite C] (s d : C → Bool) (hb : inventory s d false true = inventory s d true false) : Nat.card (Compatible s d) = if Nat.card C = 0 then 0 else if 0 < inventory s d false true then inventory s d false true * (Nat.card (Side s false) - 1).factorial * (Nat.card (Side s true) - 1).factorial else if inventory s d false false = 0 ∨ inventory s d true true = 0 then (Nat.card C - 1).factorial else 0
